phase1_leaf_result.part88_scope: Official GitHub provider-retained Git-object witness classification plus current own Part87 continuation.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: A Git commit/tree/blob SHA gives immutable content identity but current official documentation does not guarantee indefinite provider retention plus deterministic discoverability after all fork-network repositories/refs disappear or own state loses the newest SHA.
phase1_leaf_result.narrowed_positive: Public-fork network survival can preserve commits across deletion of one public repository while another active fork remains, but this is not sufficient as a zero-dependency monotonic minimum-generation/incarnation witness.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A provider-enforced repository-local monotonic witness that is reconstructible after refs and role-local state roll back, rejects delete/recreate incarnation rollback, and needs no second principal, protected/manual setup, finite quota or incremental cost.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Bounded GitHub documentation-level provider-retention/discoverability classification; no universal impossibility claim and no claim that GitHub immediately garbage-collects unreachable objects.

continuation: Part89: execute exactly one bounded GitHub immutable-release/tag witness leaf using official GitHub documentation plus own clean state only. Test whether immutable releases or provider-enforced tag immutability can supply a repository-local monotonic minimum-generation/incarnation witness without an independent administrator. Required negatives: repository admin disabling the rule, release/tag deletion, repository delete/recreate, same-name incarnation reuse, force-push/reference mutation outside the release path, loss of local newest-version pointer, API/rate-limit interruption, any plan/feature quota or paid-support dependency. Accept only if the newest witness remains provider-enforced, reconstructible and rollback-resistant under the same principal with zero optional monthly/trial/paid quota and zero incremental cost; otherwise persist the exact authority or discoverability gap.
